drafted_from: tool row in tools/wikimedia-commons/tool-rows.json (invoke http GET to commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php, prop imageinfo); the answer shown was observed from that exact request on 2026-11-13
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the Wikimedia Commons metadata for File:Eiffel_Tower_20051010.jpg and tell me its licence, size and whether credit is required." It runs tool:read-wikimedia-commons-file-metadata and hands back the licence, size, mime type and original URL.
no_lists_because: It is a read-only lookup of one Commons file page that takes a File: title and answers its metadata, and it keeps no list of yours.
instructions: 1. Get an exact File: title, from tool:search-wikimedia-commons-files or from a page you trust (a title, not a URL; no | # ? in it).
2. The AI calls tools:run for tool:read-wikimedia-commons-file-metadata with {"file_title":"File:Eiffel_Tower_20051010.jpg"}.

3. Read query.pages[0].imageinfo[0]: url (the original media), width, height, size, mime and extmetadata (LicenseShortName, UsageTerms, AttributionRequired, Artist, Copyrighted). extmetadata can hold HTML: keep it as data, never render it.
4. Only a file whose metadata says public domain, CC0 or CC-BY is a candidate; BY-SA, NC, ND, missing or conflicting rights are out. The metadata is the source's claim, not legal clearance.

worked_examples.title: Read the licence of a public-domain Eiffel Tower photo
worked_examples.ask: Read the Wikimedia Commons metadata for File:Eiffel_Tower_20051010.jpg.
worked_examples.given: Observed by sending the row's request (action=query, redirects=1, prop=imageinfo, titles=File:Eiffel_Tower_20051010.jpg, iiprop=url|size|mime|extmetadata, iilimit=1) to commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php on 2026-11-13. A Commons page can be edited, so a later run may differ.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"normalized":[{"from":"File:Eiffel_Tower_20051010.jpg","to":"File:Eiffel Tower 20051010.jpg"}],"pages":[{"pageid":3691175,"ns":6,"title":"File:Eiffel Tower 20051010.jpg","imagerepository":"local","imageinfo":[{"size":4369354,"width":4048,"height":3040,"mime":"image/jpeg","url":"https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/d4/Eiffel_Tower_20051010.jpg?utm_source=commons.wikimedia.org&utm_campaign=imageinfo&utm_content=original","descriptionurl":"https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Eiffel_Tower_20051010.jpg","extmetadata":{"LicenseShortName":{"value":"Public domain"},"UsageTerms":{"value":"Public domain"},"AttributionRequired":{"value":"false"},"Copyrighted":{"value":"False"},"License":{"value":"pd"},"DateTimeOriginal":{"value":"2005-10-10"},"Credit":{"value":"Own work"},"Artist":{"value":"a link to the uploader's Commons user page"}}}]}]}} (extmetadata also holds DateTime, ObjectName, Categories and ImageDescription, shortened here).
